## Purpose

Describe the approved change and the problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Changes are limited to the assigned lane.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or production credentials are included.
- [ ] No product database is accessed directly.
- [ ] Authorization remains enforced by the owning product and API Hub policy.
- [ ] Contracts and compatibility impact are documented.
- [ ] Tests and security evidence are included or the reason is documented.

## Contract and integration impact

List producers, consumers, schema versions, compatibility rules, data classification, tenant scope, retry/idempotency behavior, and rollback plan.

## Verification

List commands, automated checks, fixtures, and manual verification completed.

## Deployment and rollback

State affected environments, required configuration, observability, migration order, kill switch, and rollback procedure.
